title: Rory and the Velvet Glade
verses:
The moon floated up over valley and tree,
As Rory stepped out in the evening so still.
A gentle cool breeze rustled light as could be,
And drifted across to the crest of the hill.

Then Nia flew down through the purple and gold,
While Psittaco chirped from a branch in the shade.
A story of wonder was soon to unfold,
Right down in the heart of a silver-lit glade.

Soft moss formed a carpet so velvet and deep,
Where Benny leaned down with a satisfied sigh.
And Tilly was ready to nestle and sleep,
Beneath the vast blanket of dark in the sky.

Then Ricky trotted in with a quiet delight,
To gather soft ferns that were damp with the dew.
He tucked them round Rory to keep him through night,
As shadows turned slow to a shimmering blue.

Now Psittaco nestled in Nia's soft wing,
To rest as the shadows grew cozy and deep.
The crickets hummed low in a chorus to sing,
To rock all the valley so gently to sleep.

Then Rory let out a contented long yawn,
And snuggled right down in his velvety bed.
Safe nestled with friends till the pink of the dawn,
With magical dreams floating over his head.
